An elegant late-1950s Rolex Oyster Perpetual Datejust, reference 6604, with a stainless-steel case and link bracelet complemented by an 18K red-gold-plated bezel and crown. The silver-tone sunburst dial is accented with applied baton hour markers, luminous plots, gold-tone hands, and a central seconds hand. A date aperture at 3 o’clock, magnified by the Cyclops lens, displays the date “25.” The dial is signed “Rolex Oyster Perpetual Datejust” and “Officially Certified Chronometer.”

Introduced in 1945, the Datejust brought together Rolex’s self-winding movement, chronometer certification, and date display at 3 o’clocka combination that became an enduring signature of the model.  This example weighs approximately 76.28 grams and has been verified by a jeweler.
